source_data_vintage_statement: official archive retrieved 2026-08-26; IGN metadata records geometry last modified 2019-07-21 and archive members are dated 2019-09; provider does not expose a formal immutable release identifier in the archive filename
attribution: Instituto Geográfico Nacional de la República Argentina (IGN)
license_evidence: IGN's official Provincia metadata states free use of the information with appropriate citation of IGN. The repository re-fetches the official archive and verifies its exact SHA-256 rather than redistributing the archive.
known_limitations: The exact release anchor is the byte-stable official SHAPE archive retrieved on 2026-08-26, not a claim that the geometry was authored in 2026. IGN metadata states the geometry was last modified on 2019-07-21 and the archive members are dated September 2019.

The source represents Argentina bicontinentally and extends to latitude -90 through Tierra del Fuego, Antártida e Islas del Atlántico Sur. The canonical geography is not clipped for downstream map convenience.

IN1 is preserved as IGN's published two-character province/CABA identifier and is documented by IGN as an INDEC code. This release does not imply that IGN and Census geometries are interchangeable or that one authority corrects another.
The source-native GNA vocabulary distinguishes Ciudad Autónoma from Provincia and is preserved rather than collapsed.
No geometry repair, snapping, clipping, dissolve, provider adjudication or downstream poverty value is applied to the source geography.
A deterministic GeoJSON derivative may expose geography_id=IN1 for display/transport. That alias is a consumer seam within this exact release; it does not replace native_id or source IN1.
